Proposing to edit the last line of the first paragraph to link to SCP-2802.

A mild acid (pH 4) appears to be secreted in small quantities by the cap, identification of which has been inconclusive

to

A mild acid has been documented to secrete in small quantities by the cap, and attempts to identify it have shown its composition to be similar to acids founds in SCP-2802.

I feel the connection of both being acid producing anomalous creatures is a good one.

I was looking at the fact that a lot of the invincible items have that ability almost as a afterthought. Plus, many of them are "+4 items of coolness" or guys what fight good. I wanted to make something where the invincibility was the major issue, as apposed to it being one of several other powers.

In addition, doing a edit after a discussion with with my wife, where she asked "what happens if you breathe in a spore?"
